Ar! Did I ever tell thee about the time I was in ~1_CITY~ and I met ~2_GENDER~ ~3_STORY~ Anyway, 'tis a dull story.
was set upon by silent ninjas?
claimed to be an Avatar of the virtues?
claimed to be Lord British? I beat him up.
got in a duel and beat three rogues with only a pocketknife?
tried to make friendly with a tavern wench and got ale dumped on his head?
got so drunk he claimed he'd tamed a dragon?
claimed he'd tamed a dragon? They laughed, until he brought it inside the tavern!
thought this world was just a reflected image of the real one?
claimed a city named Wind exists somewhere up in the mountains?
dared me to sail around the world? He tried, and was never seen again.
claimed to be a pirate who sank whole merchant fleets?
claimed to have four wives in different cities?
said he had heard of thee? I figured he must have been lying.
turned out to be a master mage?
turned out to be a follower of Blackthorn?
turned out to be a ghost?
turned out to be a thief?
kept muttering about Shadowlords, whatever they are.
claimed to be some sort of Time Lord?
said he'd found a piece of Exodus, but accidentally dropped it in a well?
turned out to be a liche who wanted to steal my soul?
turned out to be one of Lord British's guards on a secret mission?
had some get rich quick scheme involving selling tickets to watch people kick a ball around?
was the best healer I've ever seen... until he caught ill and died.
liked the wilderness so much he got hives when he was in the city?
insisted that sailing west would eventually take you to the land where all the dead live?
said his dog was so smart it could talk?
danced on the tavern table, but fell off and spitted himself on his sword?
could tell you all about every sort of animal there ever was?
built himself a castle out in the woods?
was having a ship built in the harbor? It was huge, but it sank at the christening.
used to mutter a spell over his food, just in case it was poisoned.
said he'd been swallowed by a whirlpool, and it had turned his hair white?
was entranced by a cuddly ferret?
told me she was from another world?
claimed to be an Avatar of the virtues?
said she knew Lord British personally?
had golden hair as lovely as the sun?
kicked me really hard when I got friendly?
served the sweetest apple wine I ever tasted?
made the best apple pies I ever saw?
made the worst clam chowder I ever tasted?
thought the world was round? Ha!
claimed to have visited a magical city in the mountains?
dared me to race across Brittany Bay?
claimed to own a fleet of merchant ships?
claimed to know thee? I think she was lying, though.
turned out to be a powerful mage?
turned out to be a follower of Blackthorn?
turned out to be a pirate?
was dead but didn't know it?
had found sunken treasure but spent it all?
loved moonlight so much she slept during the day?
was so scared of the dark she always had a lit lantern?
told me I was the ugliest old salt she'd ever seen?
offered me a kiss and a wish, and like an idiot I took the kiss? She vanished in a puff of smoke right afterwards.
turned me into a toad? It stuck for two weeks, until another toad kissed me.
accidentally dropped a tray of ale mugs on my lap?
used to braid fox tails into her hair?
played the lute like nothing you ever heard?
wore so much plate mail she rusted solid and starved to death when it rained?

Greetings! His majesty thanks you for furthering the economic interests of the City! The Trade Association hath decreed that all goods shall be transported without the use of magic, for fear that use of such magics will corrupt the quality of the goods held within.  Be forewarned! The life of a trader is sure to be met with peril as highwayman and pirates alike seek to profit a bit of coin for the goods.  Good luck!

You are not currently slated to be promoted or demoted.

RENOWN

Renown amongst your warrior peers is gained on the field of battle. You will gain recognition for harming foes, healing compatriots, sneaking amongst your enemies, rooting out spies and concealed traps, and for fighting for control of sigils.

Additionally, you gain more recognition for fighting in larger battles and for fighting against larger enemy forces.

The system displays numerical ratings showing how you perform compared to the average for all current Faction members. Your rating descriptions depend on your ratings but are capped by your average activity level.

The Life of a Traveling Minstrel
A cold autumn's morning with misty fog secures a dozen brave knights, supplying hidden shelter from prying eyes deep in the foothills of the vibrant valley.

Dragons soar like fierce warriors, circling around and around, then roaring like thunder, rallying all that listen.

The dragons land swiftly beside the proud warriors,

bending necks and extending wings, lifting black claws and allowing valiant fighters to ride forth and win an arisen battle.

The increasing winds
silence the sounds of combat, and they fight, standing their ground like mothers protecting their children, bright armor flashing as each one falls.
A cold autumn's evening with misty fog cradles a dozen battered corpses of knights, creasing them in currents of winds that run deep in the foothills of the desolate valley.
Dragons glide like silent angels, circling around and around, then calling like banshees

bending their necks and extending wings, lifting black claws and pinching the sacred ground and new eternal home.
